text: Ashley Hope Perez's Out of Darkness was removed from school libraries in Lake Travis Independent School District in Austin, Texas, after some community members objected to its content, according to reports described by NCAC. Canyons School District in Sandy, Utah, ordered librarians to remove it from library shelves pending the outcome of challenges; after an ACLU of Utah investigation, the district board decided to return the challenged books to school libraries.
meta_description: Out of Darkness by Ashley Hope Perez: removed from Lake Travis, Texas school libraries; pulled in Sandy, Utah, then returned after an ACLU probe.
changes: Author-led opening; Texas case first, Utah case with its reversal second; NCAC hedge kept.
